scope_label: nonroutine variation beyond the established process pattern
definition: Special-cause variation is variation associated with a specific, nonroutine influence outside a process’s usual pattern.
explanation: A suitable control-chart signal can prompt investigation of such an influence. The signal is evidence to examine, not identification of the cause by itself.
A special cause may be removable, but first establish what changed and whether the observed departure reflects a real change rather than a false alarm.
